text:
Jordan P: noticed a small but annoying mismatch in the revenue schedules. Several credit memos issued in Apr show up as reductions to deferred liability instead of reducing recognized revenue where intended.
Leah S: do you have sample memo IDs? was this from the billing->revrec pipeline change last week?
Jordan P: sample extract from credit_memos.csv:
```
memo_id,invoice_ref,customer,date,amount,expected_treatment,actual_treatment
CM-2026-0310,INV-2026-0781,atlas-co,2026-04-12,4500,reduce-recognized,reduce-deferred
CM-2026-0324,INV-2026-0799,atlas-co,2026-04-21,1200,reduce-recognized,reduce-deferred
CM-2026-0333,INV-2026-0807,orbit-llc,2026-04-29,300,reduce-recognized,reduce-deferred
```
Jordan P: totals $6,000 removed from deferred liability; treatment should have reduced Apr recognized revenue (net-of-credits). not changing cash or customer balance, just classification.
Miguel R: materiality? threshold is $5k, so this qualifies for correction.
Leah S: what caused it? mapping change?
Jordan P: looks like a recent revrec rule prioritization change: when both invoice and memo arrive in the same batch, the system was prioritizing memo processing earlier and applying memo against deferral lines. The intended logic is to net memos against recognized revenue when memo type = "post-recognition adjustment".
Miguel R: proposed fix: 1) post reclass JE in May close to move $6,000 from DEFERRED-ADJ back to REVENUE-CREDIT-ADJ (DR 2300-DEFERRED-ADJ $6,000 / CR 4000-REVENUE-ADJ $6,000) with memo "reclass credit memos misapplied to deferred liability - RR-2026-0709"; 2) update revenue schedules to reflect the net-of-credit amounts in Apr; 3) patch pipeline rule to ensure memo processing order and add a guard for memo_type.
Leah S: agree. since cash and AR unaffected, prefer reclass JE in May close and update schedules as prior period adjustment within month-end pack. include audit notes.
Jordan P: i've created ticket RR-2026-0709 and attached CSV. revrec-bot?
revrec-bot: ticket RR-2026-0709 created; assigned to @Jordan P; due 2026-05-03; attachments required: credit memo extract, pipeline logs, JE template, PR link.
Jordan P: PR to fix pipeline: https://git.internal/redwood/revrec-pipeline/pull/314 - will attach logs.
Miguel R: i approve the JE and remediation. Leah?
Leah S: approve. please add a one-line note in the May revenue schedule: "Reclassification of credit memos misapplied to deferred liability during Apr batch processing (RR-2026-0709)."
Jordan P: will post JE in May close and update schedule note. closing loop unless auditor asks for more detail. :white_check_mark:
